# v1.4.2 — four new sources on a shared scraper

- New: four more reading sources join the library — Toonily (manhwa),
  MangaRead (manga), ManhuaTop (manhua) and WuxiaWorld (light novel). They
  appear alongside the sources you already browse, with the same search,
  detail and chapter-list behaviour.
- Improved: these four and ManhuaPlus now share one scraper built for the
  Madara (WP-Manga) site theme, so fixes and improvements to that markup
  benefit every one of them at once.
- Note: no action needed on your part — just update and enjoy.
